name: Shadcn
oneLiner: Monochrome, utility-first components with quiet borders and predictable spacing, ready for a real app.

notes: Borders on white are decorative, not text: keep body copy at the full text role and never rely on the border alone to signal state.
The focus ring is the only colour most users will see on a neutral page; keep its 2px offset intact on every interactive element.

sources.label: Palette and positioning authored for dsh-uiux; name from awesome-design-skills

default.base: height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-text); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-sm); background: var(--uiux-color-text); color: var(--uiux-color-bg); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500

outline.base: height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-sm); background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500

ghost.base: height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500

default.base: height: 36px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-sm); background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.875rem
padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-md); background: var(--uiux-color-surface)

header.base: display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600

default.base: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-full); background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500

item.base: padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); font-size: 0.875rem

do: Use one neutral scale for chrome and reserve the accent for state and emphasis.
Prefer a 1px border over a shadow: borders carry structure, shadows only mark overlays.
Keep radii at 6px for controls and 8px for containers; nothing else.
dont: Do not add gradients, blur, or glass effects — this language is flat by definition.
Do not colour large surfaces with a brand hue; the accent belongs to small elements.
Do not stack a border and a shadow on the same element.
antiPatterns: Heavy drop shadows under every card.
Two competing accents in one view.
Muted text lightened so far it drops under 4.5:1 on white.
